rca:flags.text: 1 of 23 upcasts found in the profiler data do not match a profile in the official index.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (12655 scans, 12029 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.

Bottle salinity is taken from the cruise's discrete summary (the laboratory's Autosal and cast-log workbooks are not available for this cruise); replicates are averaged and the summary's flags are applied.
